verdicts.decision_note: The client defines the software acceptance behavior for predictable styles and stable layout when transferring legacy content into new Word templates.
First concrete failure: the client reports major formatting problems observed when users move legacy content into the new templates.
First concrete verification: the client executed an old-to-new copy operation and reported that the resulting document looked great.

The freelancer's required remove-formatting and style-reapplication workflow materially conflicts with the apparent expectation of predictable direct legacy-content transfer and requires client clarification.
